property_summary: After a Collect call reverts due to insufficient balance or early unlock time, the contract's balance (Put's return) remains unchanged.
Before any external call, the contract's balance (MinSum) is 1 ether; after a Collect call that reverts (due to insufficient balance or early unlock), MinSum remains 1 ether.
After a Collect call reverts (due to insufficient balance or early unlock time), the sender's unlockTime remains unchanged.
After a successful Collect call, the sum of all account balances equals the contract's ether balance.
After a Collect call that reverts due to insufficient balance or early unlock time, the contract's MinSum remains 1 ether.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract is always >= 1 ether (MinSum) if Collect did not revert.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract strictly decreases (or stays same) iff the caller had at least MinSum balance before.
After a successful Collect call (non-reverting), the caller's balance in the contract is at least MinSum (1 ether) before the call.
After Collect, the caller's balance in the contract is always decremented by exactly _am if Collect did not revert.
After a Collect call that does not revert, the caller's balance in the contract is always at least MinSum (1 ether) before the call.
Collect can only succeed or revert when block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime
After Collect succeeds, the caller's balance in Acc is decreased exactly by the collected amount.
Collect reduces the caller's Acc.balance by the amount sent back when it succeeds.
Collect succeeds only if block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime
Collect succeeds only if block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime
The Collect function should never succeed in reentrant calls, meaning the locked state variable must remain true after the first call completes.
All calls to Collect(uint256) revert when the reentrancy lock is not released.
After a successful Collect call, the locked state variable remains true because the nonReentrant_ modifier never sets it to false.
The Collect function should always revert when called by a contract that reenters during its own execution.
The balance of the caller never decreases after a successful Collect call.
After any sequence of calls ending with Collect, MinSum remains equal to its initial value.
The value of MinSum never changes after any sequence of calls ending with Collect.
The MinSum state variable never changes after any call to Collect, regardless of input.
After a Collect call that reverts due to insufficient balance (acc.balance < MinSum), the reversal does not affect the MinSum value.
After any call to Collect that succeeds, the balance of msg.sender decrements by exactly _am.
After a Collect call, the contract's MinSum must remain unchanged from its initial value of 1 ether when the Collect call succeeds (does not revert).
After any Collect call, if the call to Collect does not revert, then the MinSum value must equal 1 ether.
